title: An interview with Galen Buckwalter, a BCI recipient in a Caltech brain implant study, on his recent ability to use the implant to produce musical tones (Emily Mullin/Wired)
summary: Emily Mullin / Wired: An interview with Galen Buckwalter, a BCI recipient in a Caltech brain implant study, on his recent ability to use the implant to produce musical tones — Galen Buckwalter says brain-computer interfaces will have to be enjoyable to use if the technology is going to be successful.
